summary: Frontend-only Playwright test of Ascend90 MVP on mobile viewport (390x844). Executed the full flow: workout screen loads with correct Friday title, taps on exercises, meals check-in, profile stats, reset modal. Most flows PASS. One critical UX bug found: the sticky 'Complete Workout' button overlays the last exercise row (fri-6) and blocks its tap on mobile — resulting in only 5/6 exercises checked instead of 6/6, so the +50 XP bonus is unreachable through normal tapping and final XP was 75 instead of expected 135.

ui_bugs.issue: The absolutely-positioned sticky wrap in app/(tabs)/index.tsx overlays the last exercise row (exercise-row-fri-6). Tapping the 6th exercise from a natural scroll position is blocked by the CTA. Playwright reported 5/6 Complete after 6 taps; consequently complete-workout-button stayed disabled and the +50 XP bonus could not be claimed. Increase scroll contentContainerStyle paddingBottom (currently bottomChrome + 100) to include the sticky wrap height + safe gap (e.g., 140-160), or lift the last row above the CTA.

integration_issues.issue: Because the 6th exercise tap is blocked and the full-workout bonus never fires, rank-xp shows 75 instead of 135, stat-workouts stays 0 and stat-exercises stays 5. State itself persists correctly across tabs (AsyncStorage + DeviceEventEmitter working). Once the overlay bug is fixed this flow will pass.

issues: Sticky CTA vertical space not reserved in ScrollView bottom padding on mobile viewport; last row visually accessible but tap target hits the CTA overlay.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — cosmetic only, does not break functionality on web preview.

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx increase ScrollView paddingBottom when not rest (currently bottomChrome + 100). Use ~ (bottomChrome + 140) or measure sticky height via onLayout so the last exercise row is not covered by the sticky Complete-Workout CTA.

After the fix, retest: tap all 6 Friday exercises, confirm progress reaches 6/6, complete-workout-button becomes enabled, tapping it awards +50 XP toast, rank-xp becomes 135 (with 5 meals) and stat-workouts becomes 1.
critical_code_review_comments: progress store correctly clamps XP at 0 on toggle-off and guards duplicate claimFullWorkout — good.
usesNativeTabs branch renders the JS Tabs on web (verified by tab bar visible at bottom).
MongoDB / backend not used — pure AsyncStorage MVP; matches problem statement.
seed_data_creation: None (AsyncStorage local, cleared via reset flow at end of run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://fittrack-gains-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Weekday during test: Friday -> 'Hamstrings + Glutes + Core' with 6 exercises fri-1..fri-6. Reset flow works. Only failing check is that the 6th exercise row is under the sticky CTA on 390x844.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: stickyWrap in index.tsx is position:absolute at bottom of the screen; the ScrollView's contentContainerStyle paddingBottom (bottomChrome + 100 on web where bottomChrome=0) is smaller than the sticky wrap height + tab bar, so the final exercise-row-fri-6 sits underneath the CTA and receives clicks on the CTA (which is disabled) instead. Reproduction: on 390x844 viewport, load /, tap exercise-row-fri-1..fri-6 sequentially -> workout-progress shows 5/6. Mitigation: increase paddingBottom or use onLayout of stickyWrap to add its measured height into paddingBottom dynamically.
